context: Tests whether the refactor skill maintains atomic commit discipline: running tests before and after every change, committing each refactoring individually with the '- r' prefix, and never adding new behavior.

checklist.name: Tests before start
checklist.description: Tests are run and verified passing before the first refactoring change begins

checklist.name: Tests after each change
checklist.description: Test suite is executed after every individual refactoring step

checklist.name: Individual commits
checklist.description: Each refactoring is committed individually with a message starting with '- r '

checklist.name: No new behavior
checklist.description: No new functionality, features, or test cases are added — only structural improvements

checklist.name: Tests unchanged
checklist.description: Test assertions and test logic remain unchanged (only import/rename updates allowed)
